anchor.text: func (q *ingestQueue) route(kind claudecode.Kind, ev claudecode.Event) (id *int64, logMiss func()) {

lines: // route decides which Muster session (if any) ev routes to. An envelope's musterSession
// field is authoritative when present, known, and its tmuxPane corroborates the session's
// recorded pane (kb:adr/ingest-envelope-pane-must-corroborate): route iff the session
// exists && (stored pane == "" — the spawn-to-record window, "cannot corroborate" — ||
// (ev.TmuxPane present && *ev.TmuxPane == stored)). Otherwise it falls back to the
// existing claude-session-id binding. An unresolved event persists with a NULL
// event.session_id; logMiss, non-nil exactly then, logs why, so the two callers (the
// worker and the handler's reply) can route without logging a miss twice.
// replyFor builds the answer to a hook post: the rename reply when it is a routed
// prompt-submit hook and its session has a title override still to send, else nil — the
// empty body every other post gets. Reads only in-memory state
// (kb:adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest), never the DB or the queue.
// titleDelivery is the in-memory record of a title override reaching Claude Code
// (kb:adr/rename-pushed-to-claude-once, kb:adr/rename-claude-change-after-delivery-clears-override):
// value is the override that was sent or found already equal to Claude's name, before is
// Claude's name just ahead of that. Never persisted, never on the wire; written only
// under Manager.mu, by SetTitle, ApplyStatus, TakeTitleToSend and MarkTitleSent.
// TakeTitleToSend returns id's title override when it still has to reach Claude Code and
// records it as sent. The ingest handler calls it on the request path, so it reads only
// in-memory state.
// PendingTitle returns id's title override when it still has to reach Claude Code,
// without recording a send.
// MarkTitleSent records that title, the override PendingTitle returned, reached Claude
// Code as a resume's --name. An override renamed since keeps its own send.
// PromptReplyTitle decodes the reply a UserPromptSubmit hook prints to Claude Code and
// returns the session title it carries. ok is false when body is not JSON, is not a
// UserPromptSubmit reply, or has no hookSpecificOutput. It keeps the reply's key
// spellings behind this package so tests elsewhere assert on the title, not the wire
// (kb:adr/ingest-wire-shaped-fixtures-via-claudecodetest).
// ingestJob is a raw ingest post. The worker does the persisting and the state transitions;
// the handler only enqueues and, to build a rename reply, parses the body in memory and
// reads session state, with no DB work on the request path (kb:adr/ingest-seq-assigned-at-ingest,
// kb:adr/rename-pushed-to-claude-once).
// TitleOverride (kb:adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins): the user's rename
// via PUT .../title, nil = none. Display-only, wins over Title in DisplayTitle() —
// never read by the state machine or the status path; mutated only by
// Manager.SetTitle.
